title: Matrix product verification program
statement: Let $n\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $A,B,C'$ be $n\times n$ matrices over $\mathbb{F}_2$. The program is the seeded matrix product verification program using the canonical map from Boolean vectors of length $n$ to $\mathbb{F}_2^n$; it uses membership-query access and returns a Boolean value.
